edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL) is a group of neurodegenerative lysosomal storage disorders characterized by excessive accumulation of lysosomal lipofuscin.

edges.subject: enzyme replacement therapy
